text: Tires first, brakes later. Tires are used to absorb the energy of the cyclist, to slow them down and to absorb the energy of their fall. The brakes are there to slow them down again and to absorb the energy of their fall. They can also be used to slow down or stop a car, to prevent a rider from hitting a tree or fence, to stop a horse from plunging, and to stop a runner from running out of gas.
